    • installLicense

      public void installLicense(InputStream license) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      Installs the offline produced license for the Slapshot Capture SDK. The license is produced from a license request made from
      invalid @link 
      {@link ISlapshotCaptureEngine#createOfflineLicenseRequest(String).
      } If not already installed, this method must be called AFTER configuration (ISlapshotCaptureEngine.configure(ICaptureEngineConfig)) and before use of the SDK capture and export calls. The installation is persistent between app sessions. No network connection is required for licensing the SDK in this manner
      Specified by:
      installLicense in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      Parameters:
      license - a stream of the license activation created offline
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error

    • activateLicenseKey

      public void activateLicenseKey(String licenseKey) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      Activates the given license key. This requires the device to be connected to the internet for the duration of the call. If successful, then a license has been installed for the device. Calls to ISlapshotCaptureEngine.installLicense(InputStream) are not required when using this method. This should be called AFTER checking to see if ISlapshotCaptureEngine.isLicensed() returns false. After a successful license key has been activated, then this call will not be necessary in subsequent app sessions because ISlapshotCaptureEngine.isLicensed() will return true. This method requires a network connection and needs to be called from a BACKGROUND THREAD because it makes a web service call. This should be called AFTER configuration (ISlapshotCaptureEngine.configure(ICaptureEngineConfig)) AND initialization ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.init(FragmentActivity, InitializationCallback) and BEFORE use of the SDK capture and export calls.
      Specified by:
      activateLicenseKey in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      Parameters:
      licenseKey - the license key to activate
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error

    • isLicensed

      public boolean isLicensed() throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      whether the SDK currently has a valid, installed license. The license could either be from a previous call to ISlapshotCaptureEngine.installLicense(InputStream) or ISlapshotCaptureEngine.activateLicenseKey(String) (). If this method returns true, then no calls to either ISlapshotCaptureEngine.installLicense(InputStream) or ISlapshotCaptureEngine.activateLicenseKey(String) are required for use of the SDK (this persists between app sessions)
      Specified by:
      isLicensed in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      Returns:

    • exportCalibration

      public void exportCalibration()
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
      prompts user for a location to save a copy of the current calibration for the device. This is meant to be used to generate a calibration file to represent the model of the device that can subsequently be used in ISlapshotCaptureEngine.addModelBasedCalibration(byte[]) if that calibration file is embedded into an app supporting model-based calibration. This cannot be called before ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.init(FragmentActivity, InitializationCallback)
      Specified by:
      exportCalibration in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI

    • addModelBasedCalibration

      public boolean addModelBasedCalibration(byte[] calibrationBytes) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      adds a model based calibration to the set of supported model based calibrations. should be the byte representation of a file that was exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration(). When a calibration is run where model-based calibration is supported/requested, if the make and model of the running device matches a calibration that has been loaded using this method, then model-based calibration will be used. If no matching calibration is found, then default calibration will proceed. Model-based calibration reduces the number of calibration captures that are required to calibrate the device.
      Specified by:
      addModelBasedCalibration in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      Parameters:
      calibrationBytes - the bytes from a file exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration()
      Returns:
      true if the calibration represented by matches the make and model of the running device
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an error occurred

    • addModelBasedCalibration

      public boolean addModelBasedCalibration(byte[] calibrationBytes, Function<DeviceInfo,Boolean> matchingFunction) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      adds a model based calibration to the set of supported model based calibrations. should be the byte representation of a file that was exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration(). When a calibration is run where model-based calibration is supported/requested, if the make and model of the running device matches a calibration that has been loaded using this method, then model-based calibration will be used. If no matching calibration is found, then default calibration will proceed. Model-based calibration reduces the number of calibration captures that are required to calibrate the device.
      Specified by:
      addModelBasedCalibration in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngine
      Parameters:
      calibrationBytes - the bytes from a file exporting using ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.exportCalibration()
      matchingFunction - a user-supplied function that will evaluate whether the running device matches the model of the calibration. The default matching function strictly matches the lower-case, invariant make and model strings of the calibration and the running device to see if the model-based calibration will be used. This allows that comparison to be overridden by the caller, in case the strict string matching needs to be altered (e.g. if the string representatio of the model changes based on the country the device is distributed in)
      Returns:
      true if the calibration represented by matches the make and model of the running device
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an error occurred

    • runCalibration

      public void runCalibration(int fragmentResourceId, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
      runs a request to calibrate the device. The device can already be calibrated. The calibration is saved or overwritten only after the calibration completes. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String). The engine takes over control of the passed in until one of the callbacks in is called. This uses the FragmentManager of the to do so. Model-based calibration is used if ICaptureEngineConfig.getUseModelBasedCalibrationByDefault() is true.
      Specified by:
      runCalibration in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
      Parameters:
      fragmentResourceId - the resource id of the fragment that the engine will use to display the views required to run the calibration routine. Control of the fragment will be returned to the caller when a call to is made
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance which will be called when the calibration terminates. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String).
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an immediate error occurred before the calibration has begun

    • runCalibration

      public void runCalibration(int fragmentResourceId, boolean tryModelBasedCalibration, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
      runs a request to calibrate the device. The device can already be calibrated. The calibration is saved or overwritten only after the calibration completes. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String). The engine takes over control of the passed in until one of the callbacks in is called. This uses the FragmentManager of the to do so. If is used, then model based calibration will be used if a model-based calibration loaded in ISlapshotCaptureEngine.addModelBasedCalibration(byte[]) matches the running device. Otherwise, default calibration will be used.
      Specified by:
      runCalibration in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
      Parameters:
      fragmentResourceId - the resource id of the fragment that the engine will use to display the views required to run the calibration routine. Control of the fragment will be returned to the caller when a call to is made
      tryModelBasedCalibration - if true, model-based calibration is used instead of default calibration
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance which will be called when the calibration terminates. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String).
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error

    • runCalibrationValidation

      public void runCalibrationValidation(int fragmentResourceId, int numberOfValidationCaptures, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      Description copied from interface: ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
      runs a validation routine on the existing calibration for the device. Routine will guide the user through captures of a target and validate the calibration based on the captures. At the end of the routine, the user will be presented with the validation results. An error or invalidated calibration will not change the existing state of any calibration on the device, it only presents the diagnostic results to the user. If no calibration is found to validate, an error is raised through the .
      Specified by:
      runCalibrationValidation in interface ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
      Parameters:
      fragmentResourceId - the resource id of the fragment that the engine will use to display the views required to run the calibration routine. Control of the fragment will be returned to the caller when a call to is made
      numberOfValidationCaptures - the number of validation captures that the user will be guided through. If less than or equal to 0, will effectively be 1.
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance which will be called when the validation terminates. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of validation, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String).
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error
